name: Memories
description: A deck of photo cards fanned on top of each other; "Start" opens the top card, you page through with arrows or by dragging card to card, and closing gathers the deck back in place.
interactionNotes: "Start" enlarges the middle card in place and the two back cards retreat behind it. In the open state the card can be dragged with the mouse: past a third of the width or with a fast throw it flips away, otherwise it springs back into place. The "next" button turns into a check on the last card and that is the end of the review; closing files the read card onto the deck and then quietly returns to the first card. With the keyboard: left arrow next, right arrow previous and Escape closes.

props.name: cards
props.description: The deck's cards (`label`, `date`, `src` and `alt` for screen readers); defaults to the component's own five memories with local photos. With a single card there are no back cards.

props.name: heading
props.description: Header of the deck state; in the open state it gives way to the current card's date.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Text of the solid Start button.

props.name: spread
props.description: Horizontal spread of the back cards' fan in the deck state, in px.

props.name: fanAngle
props.description: Rotation angle of the back cards, in degrees; zero means a flat fan.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Card width on the deck; its height is 1.2× and the open state is 1.48× the width — everything derives from this number.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open/closed state of the deck; when provided, buttons and dragging no longer change the state (for toggling the deck from outside).

props.name: index
props.description: Controlled current card (0 to count minus one); do not pass it while the deck is closed so the calm gather is not disturbed.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Returns the card number on every change — dragging, buttons, the automatic return at the end.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the card area — in both the deck and open states.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the component container.

tips: Directions are physical and RTL-friendly: "next" is always to the left — both when dragging the card and with the arrow key; the button arrows show the same direction.
Closing files the read card right there on the deck and, once it settles, quietly returns to the first card — so every time you open it the deck starts from the beginning.
The "next" button is normal until a page remains, and only on the last card does it turn solid with a check: black means the end of the review, not the forward direction.
The card throw has a threshold: more than a third of the frame or a velocity of 500px/s flips it; a half-hearted drag springs back.
Frame and button colors are `--mm-*` variables in `memories.css` tied to the site tokens — light/dark theme switches automatically; the photo gradients are deliberately fixed.
Only `motion` is needed; the photos use local paths and a plain `img` so nothing is tied to next/image and domain configuration.
